barWidget.description: Your OMP provider usage, live in the top bar, with a panel showing every provider's limits and reset times. Data comes from `omp usage --json`.

schema.description: Provider id from `omp usage --json` to show in the top bar (for example anthropic, openai-codex, devin). Leave blank to use the provider with the highest usage.
schema.label: Primary provider

schema.description: `omp usage` fetches live data from your providers, so this stays gentle by default.
schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)

schema.description: Which limit window the top bar shows for the primary provider. Auto keeps the highest percent used.
schema.label: Top bar usage window

schema.description: Whether the bar number reads what you have used or what is left of the same window.
schema.label: Show usage as

schema.description: Show the provider's short name before the usage value in the top bar.
schema.label: Show provider name

description: Live OMP (Oh My Pi) provider usage in the Omarchy bar. Reads `omp usage --json` — no separate binary, no per-vendor auth; OMP already handles all of that.
name: OMP Usage
